text: there are essentially three reasons why
people shift to any particular country
the number one reason is the opportunity
to make money so for example in Dubai
it's fairly easy to set up businesses
and save taxes even if you have a job
the personal income tax is 0% so that
opportunity to make money is what's
attracting a lot of people from high tax
countries like India or the UK to shift
to Dubai the second is the lifestyle so
availability of high quality product
24/7 electricity Supply great roads and
third is that Dubai is quickly becoming
an aspirational destination so people
always aspire to live a better and
better life now if a particular city or
a country appeals to the rich segment of
the society everyone wants to live in
that kind of a bubble so these are the
reasons why Dubai is developing really
fast and is currently seen one of the
highest rates in terms of millionaire
migration
